newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian oil reserves seen nearly tripling.
newsitem.headline: Colombian oil reserves seen nearly tripling.

text.p: The government said Monday that Colombia's proven oil reserves are expected to nearly triple by the year 2010.

The surprising forcecast was made by Energy and Mines Minister Rodrigo Villamizar at a news conference called to unveil ambitious plans to double Colombia's electrical generating capacity by the year 2010 to help cover a 5.5 percent annual growth in demand.
Success of the plan will depend largely on attracting $6 billion in private sector investment, Villamizar said.

In addition to booming growth in natural gas production, Villamizar said the government is counting on a surge in Colombia's proven oil reserves, and in crude oil production, to provide a certain source of energy for expansion of the power grid.
He said Colombia's proven oil reseves currently stand at 3.1 billion barrels but that the government sees that figure increasing to 9.0 billion by 2010.
